title: Protocol to generate induced trophoblast stem cells from embryonic stem cells in mice
protocol: Precoat the 35 mm TC dish with 1 mL of 0.2% (wt/vol) gelatin at 37°C overnight.
Dissociate the Hmgn3-OE ESCs with 0.05% trypsin-EDTA at 137°C for 3 min and stop trypsinization with MEF medium in 15 mL tubes.
Centrifuge the cells at 200 × g for 3 min and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells with fresh TSC basic medium.
Plate 5.0 × 10^4 cells on each gelatin precoated dish in TSC basic medium with 1 μg/mL DOX.
Culture the cells at 5% CO2 and 37°C in an incubator, changing the medium every day.
Observe the cell transition every day.
Dissociate cells into single cells using 0.05% trypsin-EDTA.
Resuspend cells with CDCP1 antibody solution and incubate them at 4°C for 30 min.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 200 × g for 3 min, discarding the supernatant.
Resuspend cells with 3 ml of PBS to wash primary antibodies.
Centrifuge cells and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cells with 1 mL of diluted Alexa Fluor 488 secondary antibody and incubate at 4°C for 30 min.
Centrifuge at 200 × g for 3 min and discard the supernatant.
Wash cells by resuspending them in 3 mL of PBS, centrifuging, and discarding the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 0.5 mL of TSC medium.
Filter cells through a 40-μm cell strainer into a new 5-mL BD tube to remove clumps and prepare a control sample (GFP negative) in parallel.
Prepare a harvesting tube with 1 mL of fresh TSC medium.
Sort samples on a research cell sorter according to specified steps.
Find the main population for live cells on the SSC-H versus FSC-H plot.
Set gate parameters based on GFP-negative controls.
Sort the GFP-positive cell population into harvesting tubes.
Transfer sorted cells from harvesting tubes into 15-mL tubes, centrifuge at 200 × g for 3 min and resuspend in TSC medium.
Plate cells in a fresh feeder-coated well of a 24-well plate.
Seed 2 × 10^5 cells in each well of a 24-well plate.
Add 10 μM Y27632 to the TSC medium on the first day after sorting to increase cell viability.
Observe colony morphology after sorting.
Confirm established Hmgn3-OE iTSCs by second sorting for CDCP1-positive cells, using WT-TSCs and non-OE group as controls.
Detect TSC markers CDX2, EOMES, and TFAP2C in Hmgn3-OE iTSCs via immunofluorescence.
Prepare Hmgn3-OE iTSCs and WT-TSCs on 0.2% (wt/vol) gelatin-coated coverslips for IF.
Fix Hmgn3-OE and WT-TSCs in 4% (wt/vol) PFA for 15 min at 25°C.
Permeabilize and block the cells with 2% (wt/vol) BSA supplemented with 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS for 2 h at 25°C.
Incubate cells with primary antibodies overnight at 4°C.
Wash coverslips in PBS three times (5–10 minutes each).
Incubate cells with secondary antibodies for one hour at 25°C.
Wash coverslips in PBS three times (10–20 minutes each).
Incubate cells with Hoechst 33342 for fifteen minutes at 25°C.
Wash coverslips in PBS three times (five minutes each).
Capture images on a SP8 confocal microscope.
Place round coverslips into the wells of 24-well plates coated with 0.2% (wt/vol) gelatin overnight.
Plate Hmgn3-OE iTSCs and WT-TSCs onto gelatin-coated round coverslips.
Culture cells with TSC differentiation medium at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Culture cells for six days to induce random differentiation.
Fix cells and identify trophoblast lineage-specific markers TPBPA, SDC1, and GCM1 by immunofluorescence (IF).
Precool prepared 75% ethanol solution at 4°C.
Centrifuge the differentiated cells from Hmgn3-OE iTSCs and WT-TSCs on Days 0, 2, 4, and 6 at 200 × g for five minutes.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells with 200 μL of PBS.
Centrifuge the cells at 200 × g for 5 min and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cells with 50 μg/mL PI staining solution (diluted in PBS) and incubate them in a water bath for 20 min at 37°C in the dark.
Centrifuge the cells at 200 × g for 5 min, discard the supernatant, and resuspend the cells in PBS.
Perform DNA content analysis on a research cell sorter analyzer.
Prepare 1 × 10^7 Hmgn3-OE iTSCs and WT-TSCs independently.
Dissociate the cells as per step 15 before you begin.
Resuspend cell pellet with 150 μL of PBS in a 1.5 mL EP tube and plate them on ice.
Inject cell suspensions of Hmgn3-OE iTSCs and WT-TSCs into the limbs of an 8-week-old male SCID mouse independently.
Dissect the fully-grown hemorrhagic lesions on Day 21 and fix them with 4% PFA overnight at 4°C.
Perform paraffin section according to the manufacturer’s instruction.
Perform immunohistochemistry analysis using trophoblast markers TFAP2C, SDC1, and TPBPA.
Capture images on a microscope.
